_doc: VOLTA Music library config. Tracks are indexed from every enabled root (read-only; nothing here is ever written to the music folders).
roots[]: { id, label, path (~ ok), enabled, depth? }. depth = how many folder levels below the root are scanned (default 1 = the folder itself plus one level of subfolders).

discover: ~/Documents/Audio is scanned to this depth for other folders that hold audio files; they are listed in the app as optional roots (disabled until you enable one, which adds it to roots[] here).
metaPath: per-track lyrics / credits / Suno link / tags / BPM / key. Lives on Windsor, never on the boot disk.
iCloud: a file with blocks === 0 and size > 0 is a dataless placeholder. The app never reads it (that would trigger a download); it shows 'In iCloud' and a copyable `brctl download` command instead.
